name: empty
behavior: None — presentational empty-state container; no APG pattern. The title is a real heading so the region is reachable by heading navigation, and any recovery affordance keeps its own button/link semantics. When the emptiness is the result of a completed load, the host region announces it (aria-live), not this container.

parts.note: dashed outline marks a placeholder region rather than real content — border-style-emphasis is the contract slot for that distinction
centres media + title + description as one block; layout grouping only
illustration or framed glyph; decorative, aria-hidden
action slot — hosts the recovery button(s) or a link (anatomy/button.json)

anatomyNotes: Salt has no empty-state component, so this anatomy is shadcn-only; the part list is kept deliberately parallel to card (root/header/title/description/content) so the two containers translate onto each other. shadcn's EmptyMedia variant default|icon is a RECIPE difference on media (bare glyph vs framed tile), not a variant axis.
